title: Record missing OSV dependency sources as not applicable
acceptance_criteria: OSV exit 128 is accepted only when its private diagnostic says no package sources were found.
The resulting public evidence is explicitly status:not_applicable with an empty vulnerability list and a non-sensitive reason.
Other OSV failures, including malformed JSON, remain fail-closed.
A fixture test covers the not-applicable result.

external_authorization.authorized_action: Commit and push this task to GitHub; the existing Scanner Image Release workflow may publish the scanner image to GHCR.
